question: Should maintainers review and land this PR as the combined signed marketplace feed verifier/config/refresh/schema/CLI stack, or require the earlier trust-stack slices to land first and keep this PR to CLI visibility?
rationale: The branch now spans verifier primitives, config contract, fail-closed loader behavior, SQLite snapshot state, and CLI/diagnostics output, so the permanent security and upgrade boundary is a maintainer decision rather than a mechanical review call.

options.title: Review Combined Stack After Fresh Proof
options.body: Require current-head CLI proof, then review this PR as the combined signed-feed trust landing vehicle.

options.title: Land Prerequisites First
options.body: Keep this PR open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98299, https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98316, and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98338 land or close, then rebase to the remaining CLI visibility delta.

options.title: Re-scope The Trust Direction
options.body: Ask for a narrower RFC-backed implementation if maintainers do not want signed feed config and fail-closed behavior in core right now.

recommendation.title: Review Combined Stack After Fresh Proof
recommendation.body: Require current-head CLI proof, then review this PR as the combined signed-feed trust landing vehicle.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the current PR assignee and authored the latest repair commit on this branch.
